narrative.northStar: White panels on a soft grey page, one green for action, purple for the single best release, red for risk
narrative.overview: White panels sit on a soft grey page. Dark ink carries the content, one green marks the primary action and the current selection, purple marks the one best release, and red marks risk. These are static pen.dev components in design/mediaManager2.pen; behaviour and accessibility are implementation work. The dark theme remains on the token axis mode, and the 26 dark frames are kept as the record of what changed.
dos: Do keep normal states quiet: monitored, meets profile, not aired, downloaded.
Do show row actions and key hints on the selected or hovered row only.
Do open one inline panel at a time and dim the rest; destructive actions take two steps.
Do write status as words plus a tinted chip, and every chip as a Badge instance.
Do use the words in CONTEXT.md: Release, Grab, Replace, Second version, Manual download, Pick a release, Search automatically.
donts: Don't use green for decoration or for comparisons; "better" and "not better" are text marks.
Don't use purple on more than one row per table, or red for anything that has not gone wrong.
Don't use ink-3 for readable text.
Don't add shadows, rounded controls or cards around rows.
Don't describe these static components as working keyboard controls or tested accessibility.
